text:
sam: quick question — running into a weird 401 when streaming with the Go SDK after switching to direnv/.envrc for creds. header looks ok when I print it. anyone seen direnv or shell-quoting interact badly with Basic auth?

priya: hmm — two quick checks: 1) is the API key getting a trailing newline/space? 2) are you using Basic vs Bearer? Go libs sometimes behave oddly with empty username in Basic.

sam: i tried both. curl with explicit header works: `curl -H "Authorization: Basic $(printf "%s: " "$API_KEY" | base64)" ...` returns 200. Go client gets 401.

jordan: can you paste the Go snippet? sometimes Request.SetBasicAuth("", apiKey) ends up different than building header manually. transport reuse + redirects can drop Authorization too.

sam: snippet below (shortened):

```go
req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", url, body)
req.SetBasicAuth("", os.Getenv("API_KEY"))
resp, err := client.Do(req)
// client is &http.Client{Timeout: 30 * time.Second}
```

sam: printing `req.Header.Get("Authorization")` before client.Do shows `Basic <redacted>` so looks fine.

priya: two more things: 1) direnv/.envrc can add quotes if you do `export API_KEY="abcd"` — the quotes become part of the var. 2) On some setups the API key has a stray CRLF (Windows editors) — base64 of `key` != base64 of `key`. `printf %q` or `xxd` can reveal it.

jordan: also check if you're reusing the same client for streaming + non-streaming requests; some servers expect `Connection: keep-alive` vs `close`. If a proxy mutates headers on upgrade/streaming the server may reject.

sam: tested removing quotes and trimming whitespace in env — still fails only in Go streaming path. non-streaming POST works fine.

priya: aha — streaming often uses chunked transfer and some proxys (nginx, corporate) strip Authorization on `HTTP/1.1 100 Continue` or on connection upgrade. Try setting `req.Header.Set("Authorization", headerVal)` manually instead of SetBasicAuth, and set `req.TransferEncoding = []string{"chunked"}` explicitly to replicate.

sam: trying manual set now. quick test: when i call `req.Header.Set("Authorization", headerVal)` + `client.Transport = &http.Transport{DisableCompression: true}` it worked locally (200). so looks like default SetBasicAuth + transport combo hit a proxy issue at infra.

infra-bot: FYI — we've seen a corporate proxy rewrite that drops Basic Authorization for chunked requests. Filed INFRA-4723 to add a passthrough rule for our SDK test pool.

jordan: workaround for SDK: prefer `Authorization: Bearer <token>` in customerspaces where proxies are aggressive, or set header manually and avoid the helper when streaming. we'll add a note to the Go quickstart.

sam: thanks all — will sanitize env with `export API_KEY=$(echo $API_KEY | tr -d '\r' | sed -e 's/^"//' -e 's/"$//')` and switch to manual header in SDK until infra fix. gonna ping PR for a small README note. :+1:
